name: Veramira
source:
A girl, the daughter of [url=/c166876]Joran[/url] and [url=/c166881]Sherry[/url], whom [url=/c166841]Rhiannon[/url] encountered after dealing with a group of Batyrkars in the forest. She ran away from home to find her father. Rhiannon sees an echo of her own past in the girl but does not understand why, and helps her find her way out of the forest.

[In-Game Description]
